Uings 2013 full text (PMC3831715) came back empty from the PMC tool, so the dose basis of 'comparable anti-inflammatory efficacy to FP' in mouse ICD (matched concentrations or matched effect?) is unverified; it bears on whether the 40x concentration gap in NCT01299610 is itself a potency miss (off_by_>5x) rather than within_2x on effect size.
efficacy 2015 fact fields: source_calls_it should be null, not 'miss' (Dölle's abstract characterises the result vs placebo, not vs the mouse model; comparison_stated is already false).
rule_questions: Inconclusive comparison: the brief has no status for 'compared, non-significant, CI spans the predicted effect'. Does contra require the patient result to be incompatible with the model's prediction (my reading: yes, so GW870086 at p=0.118, 59% of FP, CI -2.00..0.23 is not contra), or does failing the trial's own primary criterion while the comparator passed count as contra regardless of power? The draft's contra and my same both turn on this.

Same year, two drugs, opposite results: the override rule ('contra overrides every matched status') resolves the year only if one result is truly contra; the drafter's 'two statuses in one year would break the strip' is a figure-mechanics concern, not a rule. Also confirm that an EU-CTR sponsor synopsis PDF posted as a 'summary attachment' counts as a 'registry record' under rule 1 (I treated it as one) and that its year is the first-publication year (2015).

Safety match without the efficacy half: can a dissociation prediction ('less atrophy at efficacious doses') score same from a healthy-volunteer skin-thinning study against a superpotent comparator (clobetasol) when the same compound at the same doses showed no significant efficacy in patients? The letter of the brief says yes (four cells are scored independently); if the rule is amended to require the efficacious dose, this entry becomes untested.

Every non-untested status in this draft rests on drafter juxtaposition (comparison_stated=false for all). Rule 1 says the primary source must 'make the comparison'; the comparison_stated fact field implies juxtaposition is tolerated. Clarify which is intended, because under the strict reading both the 2015 efficacy and 2015 safety entries would fall to untested.
